items.exampleEn: The old play is a farce about a hotel full of confused guests.
items.exampleZh: 那齣老戲是一部鬧劇，講的是一間住滿搞不清狀況的客人的飯店。

items.exampleEn: She is artistically gifted and loves to paint.
items.exampleZh: 她很有藝術天分，也很愛畫畫。

items.exampleEn: My neighbor still has a darkroom in his basement.
items.exampleZh: 我鄰居的地下室裡還有一間暗房。

items.exampleEn: The final chapter of the novel is full of pathos.
items.exampleZh: 這部小說的最後一章充滿了令人動容的悲愴感。

items.exampleEn: Children love to impersonate characters from their favorite cartoons.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們很喜歡模仿他們最愛的卡通裡的角色。

items.exampleEn: In the climactic moment of the game, she scored the winning goal.
items.exampleZh: 在比賽最高潮的時刻，她踢進了致勝的一球。

items.exampleEn: A concerto is written for one main instrument and an orchestra.
items.exampleZh: 協奏曲是為一件主奏樂器和管絃樂團所寫的樂曲。

items.exampleEn: His old sketchbooks are full of drawings of cats.
items.exampleZh: 他的舊素描簿裡畫滿了貓。

items.exampleEn: Her impersonation of her grandmother at the party was very accurate.
items.exampleZh: 她在派對上模仿她奶奶，模仿得維妙維肖。

items.sentenceEn: She always carries a small sketchbook when she travels.
items.sentenceZh: 她旅行時總是帶著一本小素描簿。

items.audioEn: In the old days, photographers developed their pictures in a darkroom.
items.audioZh: 以前，攝影師都在暗房裡沖洗照片。
items.questionZh: 以前的攝影師在哪裡沖洗照片？

items.sentenceEn: The comedian can impersonate famous singers perfectly.
items.sentenceZh: 那位喜劇演員能把知名歌手模仿得維妙維肖。

items.sentenceEn: The young musician played a piano concerto by Mozart with the city orchestra.
items.sentenceZh: 那位年輕音樂家和市立管絃樂團合作演奏了一首莫札特的鋼琴協奏曲。

items.stemEn: The ____ final scene, where the hero finally tells the truth, left everyone in tears.
items.stemZh: 最後那場高潮戲，主角終於說出真相，讓每個人都流下眼淚。

items.stemEn: The show included a funny ____ of a famous football coach.
items.stemZh: 表演中有一段模仿知名足球教練的爆笑橋段。

items.passageEn: The students' end-of-year show began as a pure farce, full of silly costumes and loud jokes. The audience loved one boy's impersonation of the head teacher, which was so accurate that even the head teacher laughed. However, the second half surprised everyone with its pathos: a girl read a letter to her grandmother, who lives far away, and many parents cried. The show ended with a climactic performance of a violin concerto by the school's most gifted student, and the audience burst into spontaneous applause. Artistically, it was the best show the school had ever produced. Photos of the night were later printed in the school's old darkroom.
items.passageZh: 學生的期末表演一開始完全是一場鬧劇，滿是搞笑的服裝和吵鬧的笑話。觀眾很喜歡一個男生模仿校長，他模仿得太像了，連校長本人都笑了。不過，下半場的感人之處讓大家意外：一個女孩朗讀一封給住在遠方的奶奶的信，很多家長都哭了。表演最後，由學校最有天分的學生演奏小提琴協奏曲，把氣氛推到最高點，觀眾自發地熱烈鼓掌。就藝術表現而言，這是學校有史以來最好的一場表演。當晚的照片後來在學校的老暗房裡沖洗出來。

questions.questionZh: 表演的前半場是什麼樣子？

options: 全體學生一起上台大合唱
一位學生演奏小提琴協奏曲
播放一部學生拍的短片

items.promptZh: 那場會議根本是一場鬧劇。
referenceEn: The meeting was a complete farce.
That meeting was nothing but a farce.
rubricZh: farce 可比喻「荒唐可笑的事、鬧劇」（例如 a complete farce 等）
「根本是」可寫，例如 a complete…、nothing but… 等

items.instructionZh: 用 artistically 造一個句子，評論一部你喜歡的作品或一個地方。
referenceEn: Artistically, this film is the most beautiful one I have seen.
I think the new museum is artistically impressive.
rubricZh: artistically 表示「在藝術上」，位置有彈性（例如 Artistically, …、is artistically designed 等）
句子要說出你自己的評論

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：聽選選項格式不一：三個干擾項都是介系詞片語（Outside in the sun、In a bright studio、At a big factory），正解「A dark room」卻是名詞片語，且與音檔 darkroom 同音，格式與發音雙重洩題。建議改 In a dark room 並調整干擾項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改 In a dark room，與干擾項同為介系詞片語；干擾項長度調整，正解改為第 2 長

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：正解「最優秀的學生演奏小提琴協奏曲」長度約為其他選項平均的 2.0 倍、唯一最完整，觸及 §11-24 的 0.5～2 倍上限並洩題。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解改「一位學生演奏小提琴協奏曲」，干擾項加長，長度比降到約 1.2 倍
